tools.name: get_reconciliation_report
tools.description: Return the deterministic reconciliation result for a month: totals per provider (gross sales, refunds, chargebacks, fees, net, FX variance), payout-to-bank and payout-to-ledger matches, unmatched items and the exception count. All figures are final; do not recompute them.

tools.name: list_exceptions
tools.description: List reconciliation exceptions for a month, optionally filtered by severity (high, medium, low).
